name: kai
description: Kai in the coding loop: a Stop hook that can send an unverified 'done' back to run a check, a PreToolUse hook that can ask before an action that cannot be undone, and the kai skill for asking typed decisions. Both hooks start in shadow mode: they log what they would have done and change nothing.

hanzo_api_key.title: Hanzo API key
hanzo_api_key.description: Without it both hooks do nothing. HANZO_API_KEY in the environment works too.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow logs what the hooks would do and changes nothing; on lets them act; off turns them off. KAI_HOOK_MODE overrides it.
